scope.verification: Source hashes/bytes and integer incidence; BFS saved edges; source cached per-face area sums; arithmetic over saved distances; zero-distance coordinate witnesses only.
scope.limitation: No independent replay of orientation solver or detector. Oriented edges are saved, so directed reach is independently checked; post-orientation faces/flips were not stored, so no new solver-optimality claim. Nonzero nearest distances are checked arithmetically, not by a new full nearest-neighbor search.
